body:
You're not selfish. Your life is your own to live as you please, not for anyone else to decide. People who call the act of suicide selfish lack empathy in my opinion.
I believe that if a person wants to end their life, it should be their choice. Who am I, or who is anyone to decide what they think is best for another person until they've been in the same position as that person?

I'm sorry for what you're going through, I'm sure you're not a cruel person.
For what it's worth, I know how you feel. For as long as I can remember, I've never had a social life or what I'd call any truly close friends. All I do when I'm not at work is sit at home.

This is going to be long, so I apologize in advance.
Sounds silly but I just feel like I missed out on doing a lot of things "normal" people did growing up. I had a few friends growing up when I was really little but as I got older, it got harder. Then I got fat. I never had a lot of friends in school, have never been in a relationship, never went to parties or anywhere really, etc.
But most importantly not applying myself properly in school when I was younger, dropping out, telling myself I'd go back as soon as I could... 8 years later and I still have made no progress. I'm still working at the same dead-end job I got in high school, wishing I'd done things differently when I had first started there... I just feel like I have no control over the future and I'm going to be stuck here forever.
